title: Exquisite Greek Foie Gras Terrine
description: A romantic Greek dish featuring foie gras, shio cure, and herbs, perfect for special occasions. This low sodium friendly terrine is a delightful combination of flavors and textures.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 275 degrees Fahrenheit.
Line a terrine mold with plastic wrap, leaving some overhang for easy removal.
Season the foie gras with shio cure, thyme, rosemary, lemon zest, black pepper, and pink peppercorns.
Place the seasoned foie gras in the prepared terrine mold and smooth the top.
Drizzle the melted butter over the foie gras.
Fold the overhanging plastic wrap over the foie gras to seal the terrine.
Place the terrine in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the mold.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the foie gras is cooked to an internal temperature of 120 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the terrine from the water bath and let it cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate the terrine for at least 2 hours or overnight before serving.
